name: rps-fulfillment
description: Rock Paper Scissors packing checklists and four-up shipping label sheets.

interface.shortDescription: Faire packing checklists and Letter four-up shipping labels.
interface.longDescription: Create offline photo packing checklists from verified Faire orders and combine supplied shipping-label PDFs into four equal US Letter quarters. Includes reusable generators and validation without customer data, label purchasing, order mutation, or automatic printing.
defaultPrompt: Create packing checklists for my open Faire orders.
Combine these shipping labels into a four-up Letter sheet.
